title.narrative: Contribution to Reaching the three 95% in the fight against HIV in Comoros by 2028 and contribution to the elimination of tuberculosis in the Comoros by 2035 while respecting human rights, equity and ethics - Comoros (01-Jan-2025-31-Dec-2027)

description.narrative: Comoros, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health and Social Protection of the Union of the Comoros (DNLS)This program has the following goals: Contribuer à l’élimination des IST, VIH/sida et hépatites en facilitant l’accès, à la prévention, au dépistage et au traitement avec un focus sur les populations clés et vulnérables et une prise en charge globale de toutes les PVVIH dans une optique de couverture sanitaire universelle. /To contribute to the elimination of STIs, HIV/AIDS and hepatitis by facilitating access to prevention, screening and treatment, with a focus on key and vulnerable populations and comprehensive care for all PLHIV with a view to universal health coverage.. Contribuer à l’élimination de l’épidémie globale de la tuberculose en facilitant l’accès à un diagnostic et une prise en charge de toutes les formes de la tuberculose et en promouvant la prévention de la maladie aux Comores. /To contribute to the elimination of the global tuberculosis epidemic by facilitating access to diagnosis and treatment of all forms of tuberculosis and by promoting prevention of the disease in the Comoros. The objectives of this program are: 95% des popularions clés (HSH,TS et UDI) possèdent les connaissances exactes sur les moyens de prévenir le risque de transmission sexuelle des IST/VIH et les mettent en application /95% of key populations (MSM, SW and IDU) have accurate knowledge of the means of preventing the risk of sexual transmission of STI/HIV and are applying them. Augmenter la proportion des populations clés (HSH, TS, UDI) qui utilise les preservatifs lors des rapports à risque /Increase the proportion of key populations (MSM, SW, IDU) who use condoms during high-risk sex. Réduire la mortalité de la tuberculose de 7,7 /100000 en 2022 à 5/100000 en 2027 /Reduce tuberculosis mortality from 7.7/100,000 in 2022 to 5/100,000 in 2027. Réduire l’incidence de la tuberculose de 35/100000 en 2022 a 26/100000 en 2027 /Reduce the incidence of tuberculosis from 35/100,000 in 2022 to 26/100,000 in 2027
